Title: Guest users are unable to access SharePoint Online sites connected to Microsoft Teams

User impact: Guest users are unable to access SharePoint Online sites connected to Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, guest users are redirected to an AccessDenied.aspx page when attempting to access SharePoint Online sites where access is granted through Microsoft 365 Groups.

Current status: We've analyzed the collected network traces and determined that some guest users are being treated as though they don't have the permissions required to access impacted SharePoint sites, resulting in Access Denied responses. We're continuing to investigate why permissions that should grant access aren't being correctly applied or recognized. We're reaching out to a subset of affected users to collect additional traces that capture the process of adding guest users and assigning permissions to further our investigation.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and guest users attempting to access SharePoint Online sites where access is granted through Microsoft 365 Groups are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 9:30 AM UTC

Title: Guest users are unable to access SharePoint Online sites connected to Microsoft Teams

User impact: Guest users are unable to access SharePoint Online sites connected to Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, guest users are redirected to an AccessDenied.aspx page when attempting to access SharePoint Online sites where access is granted through Microsoft 365 Groups.
 
As a potential workaround, admins can manually add affected guest users directly to the SharePoint Members group instead of relying on Microsoft 365 Group membership propagation.

Current status: We're continuing to analyze the collected network traces to determine why permissions that should grant access aren't being correctly applied or recognized. Additionally, we've identified a potential workaround that has been successful for a subset of impacted users, where affected guest users are manually added directly to the SharePoint Members group instead of relying on Microsoft 365 Group membership propagation.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and guest users attempting to access SharePoint Online sites where access is granted through Microsoft 365 Groups are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 11:30 AM UTC
